theorems.statement: ∀ (m k N : ℕ) (ψ : Rn (m + k) → Rn N) (G : Rn (m + k) → Rn m) (Φ : OpenPartialHomeomorph (Rn (m + k)) (WithLp 2 (Rn m × Rn k))), ContDiffOn ℝ 1 ψ Φ.source → InjOn ψ Φ.source → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 Φ.symm Φ.target → (∀ u ∈ Φ.source, (Φ u).fst = G u) → ∀ B ⊆ Φ.source, MeasurableSet B → ∀ φ : Rn N → ℝ≥0∞, (∀ (V : Set (Rn k)) (χ : Rn k → Rn N), IsOpen V → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 χ V → InjOn χ V → ∀ S ⊆ V, MeasurableSet S → ∫⁻ x in χ '' S, φ x ∂μHE[k] = ∫⁻ z in S, φ (χ z) * ENNReal.ofReal ((fderiv ℝ χ z).toLinearMap.normDet)) → ∀ y : Rn m, ∫⁻ x in ψ '' (B ∩ G ⁻¹' {y}), φ x ∂μHE[k] = ∫⁻ z : Rn k, (Φ '' B).indicator (fun w ↦ φ (ψ (Φ.symm w)) * ENNReal.ofReal (((fderiv ℝ (ψ ∘ Φ.symm) w).comp ((WithLp.prodContinuousLinearEquiv 2 ℝ (Rn m) (Rn k)).symm.toContinuousLinearMap.comp (ContinuousLinearMap.inr ℝ (Rn m) (Rn k)))).toLinearMap.normDet)) (WithLp.toLp 2 (y, z))
